title: Always on top: Rounded corners not rounded

judgment.rationale: The author's reply answers the old request; do not leave this waiting or blame customization software without a clean control. Compare border transparency and rasterization on the supplied ARM64/build combination before changing the compositor path.
evidence: The report supplies an ARM64 Surface 11 Pro environment, Windows build 26300.9711, screenshots and a ZIP.
The latest author reply supplies the simple rounded-corners-enabled plus Ctrl+Win+T reproduction; disabling Windhawk did not eliminate it.
Historical #19296 was closed as fixed, but that does not prove this newer platform/build report resolved.

Upstream main 9e6593c34949: src/modules/alwaysontop/AlwaysOnTop/WindowBorder.cpp: The separate layered border window uses DWM blur setup and SetLayeredWindowAttributes color-key/alpha calls; the rounded border is not simply the target app's own corner.

Upstream main 9e6593c34949: src/modules/alwaysontop/AlwaysOnTop/FrameDrawer.cpp: The renderer already clears to transparent black and builds rounded border geometry. A missing transparent clear is not established by this report.
Read historical #19296 and the latest author answer. Neither independent ARM64 reproduction nor a pixel/composition trace was performed.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce Always On Top rounded corners behavior

fix_assessment.rationale: Conditional lightweight proposal, not an implementation-grade design. The artifact and trigger are concrete; source already has transparency and rounded-geometry handling, so the defective boundary still needs attribution.

proposed_fixes.title: Preserve transparent rounded-border corners on the affected compositor path
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: the layered-window transparency/alpha and rounded-border composition boundary produces opaque corner pixels on this ARM64/Windows configuration. The actual failing API or raster operation is unmeasured.
plan: Reproduce the supplied pinning sequence with rounded corners on/off on comparable ARM64 hardware and a clean customization control.

Correct the proven transparency or geometry boundary while preserving border color, opacity, resize and target-window behavior.
verification: Pinned windows have transparent corner exteriors on the failing platform/build.
Rounded/square borders, opacity settings, resizing and multiple pinned windows continue to render correctly.
